assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A workflow that measures actual recorded outflows and reports a three-month average with window coverage.
assessments.rationale: This is a sprint-retrospective facilitation procedure and contains no financial-data retrieval or burn calculation.

It directly retrieves the authoritative trailing average of actual outflows, defaults to three months, and requires reporting the window and months with data without turning the answer into a forecast or category report.
